name: Kimanis Power (Dua) gas-engine peaking plant, Kimanis, Sabah
description: Malaysia's first large-scale (utility-scale) gas engine facility; 21-year PPA with Sabah Electricity; EPCC consortium Synerlitz (Malaysia), China Energy Engineering Group Guangxi Electric Power Design Institute and CEEC Guangxi Electric Power (Malaysia); RM580 million Sukuk Wakalah facility rated AA1/Stable by RAM; with sister 285 MW CCGT plant supplies about one-third of Sabah installed capacity. page_read:true (WebFetch 2026-11-24).
